question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 and the Memory MVP issues handle slices, or should maintainers narrow it to a specific config/API contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory configuration, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics; automation cannot safely choose that durable product/API contract.

options.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until backend, role-slot, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge through the linked memory work.

options.title: Narrow To Role Slots
options.body: Declare https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 canonical for the slot-ownership slice, then narrow this issue to backend and flush semantics only.

options.title: Sponsor A memory.type Design
options.body: Approve a smaller builtin-only/qmd-only/mixed config design, accepting that it will still need separate decisions for plugin role ownership and memory writes.

recommendation.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until backend, role-slot, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge through the linked memory work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans public OpenClaw memory config and plugin API direction, and steipete has the strongest visible history across those current code paths.
